fields.name: blue_deposited
fields.description: Integer number of blue cubes successfully released into the bin by this decision step. Start at zero; increment at the first decision step following each completed blue-cube deposit, not at pickup or when issuing B. Preserve otherwise. Apply this definition universally in every episode, including the final deposit at the terminal decision step. e.g. 1
